SUBJECT: Consideration of Bid #E-1-20for furnishing Eight(8)New Four-Door 2020Model
Utility (SUV)Police Interceptors, for the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Police
Department
Two (2) bidders responded to this bid, and the bid tabulation is attached.
A Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting was held, and Spradley-Barr,
Wireless Advanced
Communications/Bearcom, and Recreational Electric were in attendance.
The bids were received from Fremont Motors, Casper, Wyoming (Submitted a“NO BID’), and
Spradley Barr Motors, Cheyenne, Wyoming. Sp radley Barr Motors submitted their bid with two
(2) separate body upfitter options, Wireless Advanced Communications/Bearcom ($455,715.00)
and Recreational Electric($463,379.00).
The bids were reviewed by Jared Keslar (Cheyenne Police Department) and Bryan Bell (Fleet
Maintenance).Their recommendation is to accept the bid from Spradley Barr Motors, with
Wireless Advanced Communications/Bearcom, for the purchase of the Eight(8)New Four-Door
2020Model Utility (SUV)Police Interceptors, for abid award amount of$455,715.00.
